providers.name: Miruro
providers.note: No official API. Reverse-engineered SvelteKit endpoints. Resolve on-device only - Cloudflare blocks datacenter IPs.

providers.name: AniKoto
providers.note: Standalone resolver - anikoto.cz chain (search -> watch page -> episode token -> server list -> megaplay embed). Selectable in the server picker since 0.2.11.

providers.name: ReAnime
providers.note: No official API. Streams via flixcloud.cc embeds (WASM AES-256-CBC decrypt, ported on-device in 0.2.11). Resolve on-device only - flixcloud blocks datacenter IPs.
